Class ChromaticGlyph

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.client.ChromaticGlyph
public final class ChromaticGlyph extends Object
Adapts native font glyph vertices to the sampled effect without replacing Minecraft's font.

A Scope saves the caller's graphics/context state for an entire rich-text draw. A Plan samples the colors, opacity and local transform for one glyph pass. The FontRenderer mixin routes begin/end/vertex operations through these helpers while the original renderer still selects glyph textures and emits their native geometry.

All methods touching OpenGL require the client render thread and its current graphics context. Scopes/plans nest in reverse opening order; they are not cross-thread handles.
